messages:
Pri (AE): Solaris went dark on the POC. CISO says they won't proceed until we provide a 1-page exec note + a tiny runbook proving deterministic egress + 90d audit exports. Deadline: Wed COB for their board packet.
Derek (SE): Copy. Do they require a Dedicated appliance or will Hosted+reserved egress IPs + retention addon be acceptable?
Pri (AE): They said "fast path preferred" but CISO will only sign if they can show network-level controls to their board. They explicitly called out outbound-blocking and forensic logs.
Samira (Security): Quick summary: Hosted can emit per-request metadata and we can export logs, but retention >31 days is an addon. We do not currently provide per-tenant outbound FQDN blocking on hosted. That requires Dedicated/Private or a customer-side egress proxy.
Joel (Infra): We can reserve static NAT egress IPs (INFRA-8333) and hand over a firewall allowlist. That gives them deterministic source IPs to ingest. Full outbound-block enforcement requires Dedicated.
Renee (SalesOps): Pricing note: Dedicated uplift ~+32% MRR; 90d retention addon is a fixed $X/month line -- need approval to show specific numbers. OK to show both options?
Pri (AE): Yes show both, and include a clear migration path (hosted -> dedicated) if the CISO wants to tighten controls later.
Derek (SE): I'll draft a one-pager with: 1) short tradeoffs 2) example allowlist CIDRs 3) how to validate egress is blocked/observed 4) rollback steps. Ill keep it one page for execs.
Samira (Security): I'll add an acceptance checklist the CISO can tick off: ["Static NAT IPs provided and verified", "90d log export validated (sample output)", "Blocked-host egress attempt recorded", "Rollback procedure tested"]. I'll also draft acceptable legal wording to speed signoff.
Joel (Infra): infra-bot, please open INFRA-8333 to reserve NAT IPs for tenant-solaris and prepare ACL template.
infra-bot: INFRA-8333 created and assigned to infra-scheduling. ETA depends on prioritization.
Derek (SE): Runbook snippet (draft): ```
Inbound allowlist (examples): 44.210.77.0/24, 18.197.120.0/24
Steps:
- Confirm INFRA-8333 reserved IPs
- Customer configures inbound allowlist to reserved IPs
- Run egress validation from service: `curl -v --resolve blocked.test:443:44.210.77.5 https://blocked.test/` -> ensure logged event
- Export logs: /console/logs/export?tenant=solaris&range=90d -> verify `request_id` present
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to previous policy tag `solar-rollback-2026-07-21`
- Switch traffic to stable-model-pool
- Open incident and notify customer SRE
```
Renee (SalesOps): I'll prepare a legal-ready memo + pricing appendix. Can we confirm INFRA-8333 by Tue so I can include NAT IPs in the packet?
Joel (Infra): If infra-scheduling picks this up today, NAT IPs possible by Tue morning. Otherwise Wed. I'll escalate.
Samira (Security): Legal blurb draft: "Redwood will provide the network controls described for the duration of the POC. Customer and Redwood will jointly validate egress behavior; Redwood's liability is limited to providing the controls described and documented acceptance tests." Sending to Legal for quick review.
Pri (AE): Great. Derek/Renee/Samira/Joel please drop final one-pager, INFRA-8333 link, and legal wording here when ready. I'll email the CISO packet Wed morning. :pray:
Derek (SE): Posting first draft runbook in ~90m.
Renee (SalesOps): Pricing appendix draft started. Will attach numbers after INFRA-8333 confirms NAT IPs.
Samira (Security): Acceptance checklist and legal blurb posted.
Pri (AE): Thanks team. This is critical for the deal.
